t: What he answered when they pressed him
a: وَلاَ أَنَا، إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ، سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا، وَاغْدُوا وَرُوحُوا، وَشَىْءٌ مِنَ الدُّلْجَةِ
p: Wa lā anā, illā an yataghammadaniya-Llāhu bi-raḥmah. Saddidū wa qāribū, wa-ghdū wa rūḥū, wa shayʾun mina-d-duljah
m: Not even me, unless Allah wraps me in mercy. So aim straight and keep near, and go in the morning and the evening, and something of the night.
